profile: hard-margin svm: In linear two-class classification, the hard-margin SVM minimizes ∥ω∥2^2 subject to max(0, 1 − yp(b + xp^Tω)) = 0 for each training sample p. This constraint forces the hinge term to zero and is equivalent to yp(b + xp^Tω) ≥ 1, i.e. every sample has a margin of at least 1.
